The store’s generic R8 filename omits the upstream OLED/TFT suffix. Use the exact supported target for the physical board; OLED builds do not imply touchscreen hardware.
Battery maximum differs: store 4.4 V, R2 and R8 datasheets 4.2 V. Confirm limits for the exact revision rather than applying the higher value universally.
The V4.2 datasheet and store use different temperature ranges and low-power conditions; these are not independent whole-device measurements.
R8 datasheet’s revision table is marked internal beta and contains mixed revision labels. Display-free contents and current production revision still require SKU confirmation.
Store package-size metadata differs from board dimensions. Battery, GNSS and enclosure inclusion depend on the chosen bundle.
R8 MeshCore release availability was not established; the maker page describes temporary firmware pending integration.

gaps: Match radio/antenna band, base and accessory bundle. Do not infer module support solely from a free mechanical slot; verify the exact firmware and module combination.
Store/guide disagree on SMA versus RP-SMA wording for the antenna pigtail. Confirm the actual connector before buying adapters.
The starter guide links an older RAK12500 GNSS page; current store options name RAK12501. Do not silently substitute them.
RAK14000 e-paper requires a separate firmware selection. The maker guide’s old rak4631_eink filename is not a verified current release target.
Battery, solar panel and enclosure are not universal kit inclusions. Match connector housing and polarity to the selected base; RAK19001 has distinct rechargeable/non-rechargeable inputs.
No battery-life, antenna-range, price or stock claim was independently measured or refreshed.
notes: The store contains an nRF52850 typo; the dedicated RAK4631 documentation identifies nRF52840.
Maker-listed LoRaWAN development features do not mean Meshtastic firmware runs a LoRaWAN network.
